card.name: Linking words inside official program names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, and, 's, on) in the middle of capitalized organization or program names, just before the next capitalized name word. Most often 'and' in 'Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy'.

modes.label: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy
modes.description: The word 'and' between 'Risk Evaluation' and 'Mitigation Strategy' in REMS program statements.
modes.example: BLENREP is available only through a restricted program under a Risk Evaluation<< and>> Mitigation Strategy

modes.label: Other named bodies and laws
modes.description: A linking word inside the name of an agency, survey, group or law, mostly on education or disability topics.

card.writes: It suppresses 'probability' words, so it steers the model away from continuing with that word and toward the expected name word.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining word inside a formal title, like the 'and' in Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy.
